title: Private Office Space Rental/Workstations for ICE Personnel
agency_path: HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF.US IMMIGRATION AND CUSTOMS ENFORCEMENT.MISSION SUPPORT WASHINGTON
detail_text: Scope of Work To provide flexible workspace (private offices and/or workstations) for assigned ICE personnel at approved coworking locations across the listed cities, as coordinated with approved vendor and ICE POC. Term: 12 months of coworking space use, starting upon approval/award. Workspace Details : Each site will offer a mix of workstations and private offices.
